name: Brakkulon (Age IV)
text: Crusher. Feed it ore and FE and it grinds it to dust, with a chance of a bonus item. Age IV casing, 1x speed. Has GUI, FE bar, redstone control and per-face side config.

name: Meldrathex (Age IV)
text: Alloy furnace. Takes two inputs and fuses them to an alloy, for example 3 copper and 1 iron to 4 bronze. Age IV casing, 1x speed. Has GUI, FE bar, redstone control and per-face side config.

name: Skerrivane (Age IV)
text: Sawmill. Turns a log into 6 planks, with a chance of sawdust. Age IV casing, 1x speed. Has GUI, FE bar, redstone control and per-face side config.

name: Ulmarkesh (Age IV)
text: Crucible. Melts items into fluid, for example cobblestone into 250 mB of lava. Pipes or a bucket take it out. Age IV casing, 1x speed. Has GUI, FE bar, redstone control and per-face side config.

name: Veloqith Augment
text: Augment. Put up to 4 in the augment slot: each adds 50% speed for a little extra FE per job.

name: Thrimvael Augment
text: Augment. Put up to 4 in the augment slot: each cuts the FE cost of a job by 15%.

name: Ostravine Augment
text: Augment. Put up to 4 in the augment slot: each raises the chance of bonus outputs by half again.

name: Iron Dust
text: Ground iron ore. Smelt it back to an ingot.

text: Ground copper ore. Smelt it back to an ingot.

name: Gold Dust
text: Ground gold ore. Smelt it back to an ingot.

name: Sawdust
text: Bonus output of the sawmill.

name: Bronze Ingot
text: Alloy of copper and iron from the alloy furnace. Used in Age V casings.
